query: Write the end-of-session update for the owner. Draft: 'Closed BUG-13 + SEC-4, ADR-011 Accepted, FEAT-2 unblocked, gates green, P1 escape analysis done.'
expected_behavior: Rewrites it so it ends in plain language a reader who missed the session understands
Glosses every ticket ID, decision number and acronym in the same sentence, or drops it
Keeps honest numbers (including zeros) and says what, if anything, waits on the owner
Never invents what an ID is about: each gloss is looked up in its register / decision record, and an ID that cannot be found is reported as not found or left out

query: Ask the owner which model should handle BUG-236.
expected_behavior: Does not send a bare few-word question
Gives 2-3 short sentences: what the issue is, why the choice matters, and the recommendation
Explains any technical term it must use in the same sentence

query: It's the first session of the week. Also, add a board card for building the CSV export feature.
expected_behavior: Refreshes the singleton weekly digest by replacing its body: about 10 plain-language lines (built, broke+fixed, waits on owner, next, one honest health number)
Refuses to create an engineering build card: the feature goes to the running files (status doc, backlog, owning ADR)
Any coordination ticket it does create is announced with one plain sentence in chat saying what it is and whether the owner needs to care
